title: Pagination tests do not assert nextToken is sent on follow-up requests
reasoning: Both pagination stubs ignore the incoming URLRequest and serve page 2 solely because callCount increments. A client that reads nextToken but repeats the original request without adding the nextToken query parameter would still receive the synthetic second page and pass these tests, while failing against the Portal API or repeatedly fetching page 1 in production.
recommendation: Capture each pagination request and assert that the second request contains the expected nextToken query item. For roles, also assert the account_id remains present on each paginated request.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The existing assertions only check the flattened returned items. The stub makes the second page independent of the request contents, so request encoding for pagination is untested.
suggestedRegressionTest: In listAccountsPagination and listAccountRolesPagination, store request.url values from the custom handler and assert request 1 has no nextToken and request 2 has nextToken=page2token or nextToken=rolespage2 using URLComponents queryItems.
minimumFixScope: Update PortalClientTests pagination custom handlers and assertions.
